# Purchase Order Receipts

Part of the **Purchases** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List purchase order receipts

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/purchases/purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}/receipts`

Retrieve a paginated list of receipts for a specific purchase order

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `purchase_order_id` | integer | Yes | The purchase order ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: user, owner, operationType, sourceLocation, destinationLocation, backOrder, return, partner, company, creator, moves, moveLines | `partner,moves` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of receipt IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[state]` | string | No | Filter by receipt state | `assigned` |
| `filter[move_type]` | string | No | Filter by move type | `incoming` |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `-created_at` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/purchases/purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}/receipts?include=partner%2Cmoves&filter%5Bstate%5D=assigned&filter%5Bmove_type%5D=incoming&sort=-created_at&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/purchases/purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}/receipts?include=partner%2Cmoves&filter%5Bstate%5D=assigned&filter%5Bmove_type%5D=incoming&sort=-created_at&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

    'headers' => [

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/purchases/purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}/receipts?include=partner%2Cmoves&filter%5Bstate%5D=assigned&filter%5Bmove_type%5D=incoming&sort=-created_at&page=1"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```
